Local document extraction runtime

PDF.js 6.4.299 (Mozilla), legacy browser distribution, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
pdfjs/LICENSE.txt and decoder license files retain the relevant notices.

Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and its installed Tesseract.js-core 7.x, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
ocr/LICENSE-tesseract.txt, LICENSE-core.txt and worker-LICENSE.txt retain notices.
Only the three LSTM core variants selected by OEM=1 are included.

Russian and English LSTM models from the official Tesseract.js language repository:
https://github.com/naptha/tessdata/tree/gh-pages/4.0.0_best_int
ocr/lang/LICENSE.txt retains the Apache-2.0 language-data license.

All runtime modules, workers, WASM and language models are served by this website.
No medical document, extracted text or image is sent to an OCR provider.
Default CDN strings inside upstream bundles are overridden with local URLs.
Source maps, samples, package caches and development dependencies are excluded.
